articles.title: Osun projects N250bn IGR, N230bn donor funds in N927bn 2027 budget
articles.summary: The Osun State Government has set an ambitious revenue target of ₦250.17 billion from internally generated revenue (IGR) and projected another ₦230.65 billion from development partners as part of its financing plan for the proposed ₦927.37 billion 2027 budget. The projections, which place considerable expectations on the state’s revenue-generating capacity and development partnerships, forme
articles.hausa_translation: Gwamnatin Osun ta shirya saduwar kudin gida na ₦250.17 biliyan da kuma ₦230.65 biliyan daga abokan gida a cikin kasua na ₦927.37 biliyan a shekara ta 2027. Waɗannan shirye-shiryen suna nuna babbar tsammani akan iko na kasua na saduwa da haɗin gida.
critical_questions: What is the track record of Osun State's actual IGR performance versus previous projections - has it consistently met targets or fallen short?

Why is nearly 25% of the budget dependent on external donor funds - what does this reveal about the state's fiscal sustainability and dependency?

articles.hausa_translation: Arewa ta damje jami'in Switzerland, ta umarce buɗewa ofishin sa. Arewa ta umarce shugaban ofishin diplomashi na Switzerland a Pyongyang ya tafi gida cikin sa'o'i 45 bayan wata rikici game da hana jaraba a gida mai bukatarwa ga yara.

How reliable is this reporting given North Korea's restricted media environment, and are there corroborating sources from Switzerland or international observers?

The programme covers seven Nigerian universities and two […]

An aiwatar da aiki a ƙarƙashiyar Phase II na Energizing Education Programme (EEP), wanda Jami'ar Duniya ta karanta kuma Rural Electrification Agency (REA) ya aiwatar.

articles.title: Gov Mbah Mourns Pete Edochie
articles.summary: Enugu State Governor, Dr Peter Mbah, has expressed grief over the death of veteran Nollywood actor, Chief Pete Edochie, describing his passing as the departure of a giant, cultural icon and patriot. Mbah described the death as a personal loss to Enugu State, recalling that although the renowned actor hailed from Nteje in Anambra State, […]
articles.hausa_translation: Gwamnan Mbah Ya Murmushi Pete Edochie - Gwamnan Jihar Enugu, Dr Peter Mbah, ya bayyana bakin ciki game da mutuwar sanin jaridar gida, Chief Pete Edochie, wanda ya bayyana cewa shi ne babbar mutum, abokin al'ada da mai kare kasua. Mbah ya ce mutuwar shi ne hasarar gida ga Jihar Enugu, duk da cewa sanin jaridar ya fito ne daga Nteje a Jihar Anambra.

Does the governor's eulogy serve broader political interests in positioning himself as custodian of cultural heritage ahead of potential elections?
What evidence exists that Edochie maintained active ties to Enugu State beyond his birth origin in the broader region?

articles.title: Unverified Reports Could Undermine National Security, Safety Heritage Warns
articles.summary: The Centre for Safety Heritage has called on Nigerian media organisations and journalists to embrace nationalism and patriotism in their reportage, particularly on defence and security matters, without compromising professional ethics or their responsibility to hold public institutions accountable. The organisation made the call while commending the Defence Headquarters (DHQ) for organising the tw
articles.hausa_translation: Labarin da ba a tabbatar da shi zai iya lalata tsaron kasar, kewayon Heritage na Safety na faɗi. Gida na Safety Heritage ya kira ƴan jarida da masu labarin Nijeriya su rika aiki da kishin kasar da ƴaddamarwa a ciki, musamman game da abubuwan tsaro da gida, ba tare da karɓar aiki na ƙwararru ko halin da suke da alaka da jangantaccen kasuwansu ba. Ƙungiya ta yaba wa Hedkwotaz Tsaro (DHQ) sakamakon shirye-shirye.
critical_questions: Who funds the Centre for Safety Heritage and what are its institutional ties to the military or government?
What specific 'unverified reports' prompted this warning, and why were they not named or contextualized?
How does the call for 'nationalism' in security reporting differ from censorship or self-censorship of legitimate accountability journalism?
Why was this statement framed as a commendation of DHQ rather than an independent assessment of media freedom standards?
What evidence demonstrates that unverified reports have actually undermined national security, versus this being an assertion?

articles.title: CAF Snubs Osimhen, Salah As 3 Moroccans, 2 Senegalese Make Player Of The Year Final List

Reigning holder Achraf Hakimi, fellow Moroccans Brahim Diaz and Ismael Saibari, alongside Senegalese duo Sadio Mané and […]

articles.title: My finances were better before Tinubu’s tenure – Seyi Law

articles.title: Nigeria’s ₦1.06 trillion time bomb: The government owes, businesses bleed, By Jude Dike
articles.summary: According to BudgIT’s 2025 State of States report, Nigerian states carried approximately ₦1.06 trillion in outstanding contractor, pension and gratuity obligations in 2024. Contractor arrears alone accounted for ₦434.87 billion. Thirty states reported outstanding obligations in one or both categories… At the federal level, the 2026 budget proposal provided ₦1.7 trillion to address outs
articles.hausa_translation: Bakin jini na ₦1.06 trillion na Nigeria: Gwamnati ta yin bashi, kasuwanci na yin bakin ciki. Jamic BudgIT na 2025 ya nuna cewa jihojen Nigeria suna da ₦1.06 trillion wajen ba da kudin ma'aikata, pensho da kyautai. Ƙwancewa na ma'aikata kaɗai ya kai ₦434.87 billion.
critical_questions: Who benefits most from these unpaid obligations—which contractors, pension holders, and service providers have political connections that might explain payment delays?
Why do 30 states have these arrears and what distinguishes the states that don't—is there a pattern in fiscal management, revenue generation, or political party control?
The federal government allocated ₦1.7 trillion for 2026, but were previous similar allocations actually spent on clearing arrears or diverted elsewhere?
Whose voices are missing—have journalists interviewed affected contractors, pensioners, and families depending on gratuities about the human cost of these delays?
Is the ₦1.06 trillion figure complete or does it represent only reported/auditable arrears, with potentially more hidden in informal systems?

articles.title: El-Rufai recants, denies tapping Ribadu’s phone

El-Rufai, who stated this when he opened his defence before Justice Joyce Abdulmalik of the Federal High Court in Abuja, also denied asking anyone to do so. The former governor told the […]
articles.hausa_translation: Tsohon Gwamna Nasir El-Rufai na Kaduna State ya karshe jiya cewa bai tsinkayi sabon saƙon Mallam Nuhu Ribadu, Jami'in Tsaron Kasa ba. El-Rufai ya bayyana haka a lokacin da yake buɗewa karɓɓan kaifinsa a gabar Alkali Joyce Abdulmalik na Kotun Tarayya a Abuja.

Abdulaziz Yari of the All Progressives Congress (APC). This is contained in a statement issued by the Coordinator of Yari’s constituency office, Sha’ayau’u Sarkinfawa on Wednesday in Gusau. According to him, the candidates announced their […]
articles.hausa_translation: Shafinan Zamfara: Shafinan jiya sun janye domin Yari - Wasu sha'anan shafinan kundin jiya daga jam'iyyofi daban-daban da suke fafatawa shafiniyar Zamfara Yammа sun janye domin goyon bayan jajere Sen.
